Consumer Authority Acts Against 41 Restaurants Over Service Charge

India's consumer protection authority has taken action against 41 restaurants, including Chaayos, for levying service charges. The crackdown aims to address consumer complaints regarding the mandatory addition to bills. This move highlights ongoing efforts to enforce consumer rights in the food service industry.
